question: Show all customer names, ids and the number of orders by each customer.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "customers" AS SELECT "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "customer_number" AS "customer_number", "customer_name" AS "customer_name" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "orders" AS SELECT CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS order_id, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS customer_id WHERE 1=0

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_id ASC

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  COALESCE(cnt.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
) cnt
ON cnt.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_name ASC, c.customer_id ASC

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,

FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
) cnt
ON cnt.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_name ASC, c.customer_id ASC
